label: 显式 phone 规则与 gold regexp
sql: WITH x AS(SELECT regexp_replace(phone,'[^0-9+]','','g') p FROM raw.contact_history_data WHERE coalesce(try_cast(_fivetran_active AS BOOLEAN),true)) SELECT count(*) FILTER(WHERE regexp_full_match(p,'^[+][1-9][0-9]{1,14}$')) contract_valid,count(*) FILTER(WHERE regexp_full_match(p,'^\\+[1-9]\\d{1,14}$')) gold_valid FROM x
